g.source: The gram, the canonical mass unit of every computation.

kg.source: SI prefix kilo: 1 kg = 1000 g exactly.

oz.source: International avoirdupois ounce = 1 lb / 16 = 453.59237 g / 16 exactly (16 ounces = 1 pound: NIST Handbook 44 (2026), Appendix C, Avoirdupois Units of Mass; pound: Federal Register 24 (128), p. 5348, 1959-07-01, National Bureau of Standards, Refinement of values for the yard and the pound).

lb.source: International avoirdupois pound = 0.45359237 kg exactly (1 pound (avoirdupois) = 0.453 592 37 kilogram: Federal Register 24 (128), p. 5348, 1959-07-01, National Bureau of Standards, Refinement of values for the yard and the pound).

ml.source: The millilitre, the canonical volume unit: 1 ml = 1 cm3.

tsp.source: US customary teaspoon = 1 tbsp / 3 = 4.92892159375 ml exactly (1 gallon = 231 cubic inches = 128 fluid ounces, 1 inch = 2.54 centimeters exactly, cup = 8 fluid ounces, tablespoon = 1/2 fluid ounce = 3 teaspoons: NIST Handbook 44 (2026), Appendix C).

tbsp.source: US customary tablespoon = 1 cup / 16 = 14.78676478125 ml exactly (1 gallon = 231 cubic inches = 128 fluid ounces, 1 inch = 2.54 centimeters exactly, cup = 8 fluid ounces, tablespoon = 1/2 fluid ounce = 3 teaspoons: NIST Handbook 44 (2026), Appendix C).

cup.source: US customary cup = 1 US gallon / 16 = 231 * 2.54^3 / 16 ml = 236.5882365 ml exactly (1 gallon = 231 cubic inches = 128 fluid ounces, 1 inch = 2.54 centimeters exactly, cup = 8 fluid ounces, tablespoon = 1/2 fluid ounce = 3 teaspoons: NIST Handbook 44 (2026), Appendix C).

imp-floz.source: Imperial fluid ounce = 1/20 pint = 1/160 gallon = 28.4130625 ml exactly (1 gallon = 4.546 09 cubic decimetres, quart = 1/4 gallon, pint = 1/2 quart, gill = 1/4 pint, fluid ounce = 1/20 pint: Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1, Part IV, legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-11-19).

imp-gill.source: Imperial gill = 1/4 pint = 1/32 gallon = 142.0653125 ml exactly (1 gallon = 4.546 09 cubic decimetres, quart = 1/4 gallon, pint = 1/2 quart, gill = 1/4 pint, fluid ounce = 1/20 pint: Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1, Part IV, legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-11-19).

imp-pint.source: Imperial pint = 1/2 quart = 1/8 gallon = 568.26125 ml exactly (1 gallon = 4.546 09 cubic decimetres, quart = 1/4 gallon, pint = 1/2 quart, gill = 1/4 pint, fluid ounce = 1/20 pint: Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1, Part IV, legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-11-19).

imp-quart.source: Imperial quart = 1/4 imperial gallon = 1136.5225 ml exactly (1 gallon = 4.546 09 cubic decimetres, quart = 1/4 gallon, pint = 1/2 quart, gill = 1/4 pint, fluid ounce = 1/20 pint: Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1, Part IV, legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-11-19).

count.source: A counted piece; its mass is the ingredient's own unitWeightG, never a default.
